value.rationale: The four-by-four grid is the first balanced square where the information-theoretic leaf ceiling is unattainable despite perfectly balanced first comparisons. The finite classification is motivated by a sharp structural transition rather than an arbitrary parameter slice; the newly exposed nested bottleneck distinguishes static answer balance from feasible adaptive depth and is a natural calibration example for online shattering of linear extensions.
